_notes: Locally added for the leaderboards of VPX -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for Juegos Populares games.
Found by watching every byte of the RAM (0x4000-0x47FF) through an automated 2-player game (Doc/test-hooks/score-probe.py).
Scores: 3 bytes of packed BCD, most significant first, from 0x43CF on a 3-byte stride. 0x43CF and 0x43D2 went to 0 at the start
and rose with players 1 and 2 only (final 25,870 / 20,543 in memory, the end of game bonus included); players 3 and 4 follow
the stride (in attract mode the machine copies one score to the four slots 0x43CF-0x43DA).
scale 10: inferred, not seen on a display. The ROM drives 7-digit displays (jpDisp7) but keeps 6 digits per player with no room
for a 7th, so the 7th is a constant: a trailing 0, as on the Peyper/Sonic 7-digit games, and as the 6-digit faeton6d ROM suggests.
player_count 0x43EE (0, then 1 and 2 at each start, 0 at the end of the game: game_over), current_player 0x43EF, current_ball 0x440A.
